analysis.title: GS Quek - MACRO SERIES: Hedging Taiwan Tech
key_insights: Hedge funds' Taiwan positioning is the steepest in the region: they entered October with gross allocation at the 79th percentile and net allocation at the 93rd percentile of the one-year lookback.

The desk sees a rising need for near-term protection, citing hotter US inflation overnight, concerns about AI-driven funding, rising China competition, and questions about the durability of the AI capex cycle.
Taiwan positioning remains at record levels while Korea is seeing meaningful net selling.
TSMC reports Q3 earnings at 2PM today. The desk describes expectations as elevated and the bar as high to reaccelerate the broader AI trade. Shares were down about 2% in the morning.

The desk stays structurally constructive on Taiwan and AI, but says crowded positioning makes Taiwan's AI hardware complex more vulnerable to near-term downside, so it recommends tactical protection through custom basket total return swaps (TRS).

sector_views.rationale: The desk is structurally constructive on Taiwan and AI, but crowded positioning raises near-term downside risk, so it recommends tactical hedges.

earnings_insights: TSMC Q3 earnings are due at 2PM ET on 15 Oct 2026. The desk says expectations are elevated and the bar is high to reaccelerate the broader AI trade. No estimate figures are given.

macro_indicators.reading: Described as hotter overnight, no figure given
macro_indicators.interpretation: The hotter US inflation print is cited as one reason the need for near-term protection on Taiwan tech is increasing.

trade_ideas.description: Short total return swap on GS Taiwan Semis basket (GSXATWSM, 10 names) at SOFR-120bps, plus market charges and HT comms, as a tactical hedge
trade_ideas.rationale: Crowded HF positioning leaves Taiwan's AI hardware complex more vulnerable to near-term downside.
trade_ideas.risk: Max loss on a Short TRS is unlimited. Max loss on a Long TRS is notional plus financing spent.

trade_ideas.description: Short total return swap on GS Taiwan Tech ex TSMC basket (GSXATTXT, 41 names) at SOFR-200bps, plus market charges and HT comms, as a tactical hedge
trade_ideas.rationale: Crowded HF positioning leaves Taiwan's AI hardware complex more vulnerable to near-term downside.
trade_ideas.risk: Max loss on a Short TRS is unlimited. Max loss on a Long TRS is notional plus financing spent.

risk_factors: Durability of the AI capex cycle
vol_and_positioning: HF gross/net allocation to Taiwan was at the 79th/93rd percentile of the one-year lookback entering October, the steepest in the region.
Taiwan positioning is at record levels, in contrast to meaningful net selling in Korea.
Pricing for the hedges: GSXATWSM at SOFR-120bps and GSXATTXT at SOFR-200bps, both plus market charges and HT comms. Pricing is as of 15Oct26 and subject to refresh.
geopolitical: Rising China competition is cited as a concern for Taiwan tech.
